Healthcare Direct (HealthCare Direct Ltd)
does not focus on or sell high-tech consumer or remote electronic wearable medical devices
; its inventory centers on standard medical consumables, patient pressure care, and daily living aids rather than digital or biometric wearables.
LinkedIn
Founding Year:
1993 (incorporated in the UK in 2001)
Headquarters:
Borehamwood, Hertfordshire, United Kingdom
What the Company Does:
It supplies medical, nursing, and dental consumables, pressure care equipment, fall protection, and patient-handling aids to care homes, the National Health Service (NHS), businesses, and private individuals.

. Devices range from prescription skin sensors for diabetes to smartwatches with heart checks and home kits that send vital signs directly to a doctor.
